euclid-2016-q1.summary: (a) Find the average of $5,15,25,35,45,55$. (b) If $x^2=2016$, evaluate $(x+2)(x-2)$. (c) The collinear points $P(7,5)$, $Q(a,2a)$, and $R(12,30)$ are given. Find $a$.

methods.title: Pair the data, use a difference of squares, and compare slopes
methods.titleZh: 配对求平均、使用平方差并比较斜率
steps: (a) Pair the first and last entries: $5+55=15+45=25+35=60$. Thus the total is $3(60)=180$, and the average is $180/6=30$.
(b) Apply the difference-of-squares identity: $(x+2)(x-2)=x^2-4=2016-4=2012$. The value is independent of the sign of $x$.

(c) Since the three points are collinear, $m_{PQ}=m_{PR}$. Now $m_{PR}=(30-5)/(12-7)=5$, so $(2a-5)/(a-7)=5$. The case $a=7$ would make $PQ$ vertical while $PR$ is not, so it is excluded. Solving $2a-5=5a-35$ gives $a=10$, and $Q=(10,20)$ indeed lies on the same line.

euclid-2016-q2.summary: (a) Solve $n/9=25/n$. (b) Solve $(x-3)(x-2)=6$. (c) Two apples cost the same as three bananas. If six apples and twelve bananas cost 6.30 dollars, find the cost of one apple.
euclid-2016-q2.summaryZh: (a) 解方程 $n/9=25/n$。(b) 解方程 $(x-3)(x-2)=6$。(c) 两个苹果与三个香蕉价格相同；若六个苹果和十二个香蕉共需 6.30 美元，求一个苹果的价格。

methods.title: Clear denominators, factor, and model the prices
methods.titleZh: 消去分母、因式分解并建立价格模型
steps: (a) The equation requires $n\ne0$. Multiplying by $9n$ gives $n^2=225$, hence $n=15$ or $n=-15$. Both values satisfy the original equation.
(b) Expanding gives $x^2-5x+6=6$, hence $x^2-5x=x(x-5)=0$. Therefore $x=0$ or $x=5$.
(c) Let an apple cost $a$ dollars and a banana cost $b$ dollars. The data give $2a=3b$ and $6a+12b=6.30$. Since $12b=4(3b)=8a$, we get $14a=6.30$, so $a=0.45$ dollars.
stepsZh: (a) 原方程要求 $n\ne0$。两边同乘 $9n$ 得 $n^2=225$，所以 $n=15$ 或 $n=-15$；两值代回均成立。
(c) 设一个苹果和一个香蕉的价格分别为 $a,b$ 美元。题意给出 $2a=3b$ 与 $6a+12b=6.30$。因 $12b=4(3b)=8a$，所以 $14a=6.30$，得到 $a=0.45$ 美元。

euclid-2016-q3.summary: (a) Points $A,B,C$ are collinear in that order. Three triangles $ABD$, $BFG$, and $BCE$ lie above the line, with $F$ on $BD$ and $G$ on $BE$. Their six angles away from $B$ are $p=\angle DAB$, $q=\angle ADB$, $r=\angle BFG$, $s=\angle FGB$, $t=\angle BEC$, and $u=\angle ECB$. Find $p+q+r+s+t+u$. (b) If $n=10^{20}-20$, find the sum of the digits of $n$. (c) A parabola crosses the $x$-axis at $P(2,0)$ and $Q(8,0)$ and has vertex $V$ below the axis. If triangle $VPQ$ has area $12$, find $V$.
euclid-2016-q3.summaryZh: (a) 点 $A,B,C$ 依次共线。直线上方有三个三角形 $ABD,BFG,BCE$，其中 $F$ 在 $BD$ 上、$G$ 在 $BE$ 上；六个不在 $B$ 点的角为 $p=\angle DAB$、$q=\angle ADB$、$r=\angle BFG$、$s=\angle FGB$、$t=\angle BEC$、$u=\angle ECB$。求 $p+q+r+s+t+u$。(b) 若 $n=10^{20}-20$，求 $n$ 的各位数字之和。(c) 一条抛物线与 $x$ 轴交于 $P(2,0),Q(8,0)$，顶点 $V$ 位于 $x$ 轴下方。若三角形 $VPQ$ 面积为 $12$，求 $V$ 的坐标。

methods.title: Use angle sums, place value, and parabola symmetry
methods.titleZh: 利用角和、位值与抛物线对称性
steps: (a) The three triangles have total angle sum $3(180^\circ)=540^\circ$. Their three angles at $B$ fill the straight angle from $BA$ to $BC$, so those angles sum to $180^\circ$. The remaining six angles therefore sum to $540^\circ-180^\circ=360^\circ$.
(b) Subtracting $20$ from $10^{20}$ gives the decimal number consisting of eighteen $9$s followed by $80$. Hence the digit sum is $18(9)+8+0=170$.
(c) The base $PQ$ has length $8-2=6$. If $h$ is the distance from $V$ to the $x$-axis, then $\frac12(6)h=12$, so $h=4$. Since $V$ is below the axis, its $y$-coordinate is $-4$.
The axis of symmetry lies midway between the two roots, so the $x$-coordinate of the vertex is $(2+8)/2=5$. Therefore $V=(5,-4)$.
stepsZh: (a) 三个三角形的内角总和为 $3(180^\circ)=540^\circ$。它们在 $B$ 点的三个角恰好拼成从 $BA$ 到 $BC$ 的平角，和为 $180^\circ$。故余下六角之和为 $540^\circ-180^\circ=360^\circ$。
(b) 从 $10^{20}$ 中减去 $20$，所得十进制数由十八个 $9$ 后接 $80$ 组成。因此各位数字和为 $18(9)+8+0=170$。
(c) 底边 $PQ$ 长为 $8-2=6$。设 $V$ 到 $x$ 轴的距离为 $h$，则 $\frac12(6)h=12$，故 $h=4$。因 $V$ 在 $x$ 轴下方，其纵坐标为 $-4$。
抛物线对称轴位于两个零点的中点，所以顶点横坐标为 $(2+8)/2=5$。因此 $V=(5,-4)$。

euclid-2016-q4.summary: (a) Find all $0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$ satisfying $\sin^2\theta+2\cos^2\theta=7/4$. (b) Two circle radii have sum $10$ cm, and the larger circumference exceeds the smaller by $3$ cm. Find the difference of their areas.
euclid-2016-q4.summaryZh: (a) 求所有满足 $0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$ 且 $\sin^2\theta+2\cos^2\theta=7/4$ 的角 $\theta$。(b) 两圆半径之和为 $10$ cm，大圆周长比小圆多 $3$ cm，求两圆面积之差。

methods.title: Reduce the identity and factor the area difference
methods.titleZh: 化简三角恒等式并分解面积差
steps: (a) Since $\sin^2\theta+\cos^2\theta=1$, the equation becomes $1+\cos^2\theta=7/4$. Thus $\cos^2\theta=3/4$ and $\cos\theta=\pm\sqrt3/2$.
On $0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$, these cosine values occur at $30^\circ$ and $150^\circ$. Both satisfy the original equation.
(b) Let the smaller and larger radii be $r$ and $R$. Then $r+R=10$ and $2\pi(R-r)=3$. The required difference is $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(R-r)(R+r)=\frac12[2\pi(R-r)](R+r)=\frac12(3)(10)=15\text{ cm}^2$.
stepsZh: (a) 由 $\sin^2\theta+\cos^2\theta=1$，原方程化为 $1+\cos^2\theta=7/4$。所以 $\cos^2\theta=3/4$，即 $\cos\theta=\pm\sqrt3/2$。
在 $0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$ 内，相应角为 $30^\circ$ 与 $150^\circ$；两者代回原式均成立。
(b) 设小圆、大圆半径为 $r,R$。则 $r+R=10$ 且 $2\pi(R-r)=3$。所求面积差为 $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(R-r)(R+r)=\frac12[2\pi(R-r)](R+r)=\frac12(3)(10)=15\text{ cm}^2$。

euclid-2016-q5.summary: (a) A store buys a calculator for $p>0$, marks it up by $n\%$, and then discounts the marked price by $20\%$. The final price is $20\%$ above $p$. Find $n$. (b) For an integer $n$, define $f(n)=n-1$ when $n$ is odd and $f(n)=n^2-1$ when $n$ is even. Find all integers $n$ satisfying $f(f(n))=3$.
euclid-2016-q5.summaryZh: (a) 商店以 $p>0$ 的价格购入计算器，先加价 $n\%$，再按新价格降价 $20\%$；最终价格比 $p$ 高 $20\%$。求 $n$。(b) 对整数 $n$，若 $n$ 为奇数则 $f(n)=n-1$，若 $n$ 为偶数则 $f(n)=n^2-1$。求所有满足 $f(f(n))=3$ 的整数 $n$。

methods.title: Use multiplicative percentages and split by parity
methods.titleZh: 用乘法处理百分比并按奇偶性分类
steps: (a) The two price changes multiply $p$ by $(1+n/100)(0.8)$. The final multiplier is $1.2$, so $0.8(1+n/100)=1.2$. Thus $1+n/100=1.5$ and $n=50$.
(b) If $n$ is even, then $f(n)=n^2-1$ is odd. Hence $f(f(n))=(n^2-1)-1=n^2-2$. The equation $n^2-2=3$ would require $n^2=5$, giving no integer solution.
If $n$ is odd, then $f(n)=n-1$ is even. Therefore $f(f(n))=(n-1)^2-1=n^2-2n$. Setting this equal to $3$ gives $n^2-2n-3=(n-3)(n+1)=0$.
Both $n=3$ and $n=-1$ are odd and satisfy the original nested equation. These are all solutions.
stepsZh: $n=3$ 与 $n=-1$ 都是奇数，且代回嵌套方程成立。因此解仅有这两个。

euclid-2016-q6.summary: (a) Find the smallest positive integer $x$ such that $1/32=x/10^y$ for some positive integer $y$. (b) A right triangle has one side of length $60$, and its three side lengths form an arithmetic sequence. Find every possible area.
euclid-2016-q6.summaryZh: (a) 求最小正整数 $x$，使得对某个正整数 $y$ 有 $1/32=x/10^y$。(b) 一个直角三角形有一边长为 $60$，且三边长构成等差数列。求其所有可能面积。

methods.title: Match prime powers and classify arithmetic right triangles
methods.titleZh: 匹配素因子幂并刻画等差直角三角形
steps: (a) Cross-multiplication gives $32x=10^y$. Since $32=2^5$ and $10^y=2^y5^y$, we need $x=2^{y-5}5^y$ with $y\ge5$. The smallest choice is $y=5$, yielding $x=5^5=3125$; indeed $32(3125)=10^5$.

(b) Write the ordered side lengths as $a-d,a,a+d$, where $a>d>0$. Pythagoras gives $(a-d)^2+a^2=(a+d)^2$, which simplifies to $a^2=4ad$, so $a=4d$. Thus every such triangle has side lengths $3d,4d,5d$.
If $60=3d$, then $d=20$, the legs are $60,80$, and the area is $\frac12(60)(80)=2400$. If $60=4d$, then $d=15$, the legs are $45,60$, and the area is $1350$.
If $60=5d$, then $d=12$, the legs are $36,48$, and the area is $\frac12(36)(48)=864$. These three cases exhaust the possible position of the side of length $60$.
stepsZh: (b) 将递增的三边写成 $a-d,a,a+d$，其中 $a>d>0$。由勾股定理，$(a-d)^2+a^2=(a+d)^2$，化简为 $a^2=4ad$，故 $a=4d$。所以这类三角形的边长必为 $3d,4d,5d$。
若 $60=5d$，则 $d=12$，两直角边为 $36,48$，面积为 $\frac12(36)(48)=864$。边长 $60$ 在三边中的位置只有这三种，故已穷尽。

euclid-2016-q7.summary: (a) Amrita and Zhang cross a lake using a one-seat kayak. Each paddles at $7$ km/h and swims at $2$ km/h. Amrita first paddles while Zhang swims, leaves the kayak stationary and swims, and Zhang later reaches it and paddles. Both finish together after $90$ minutes. How long was the kayak stationary? (b) Find all real pairs $(x,y)$ satisfying $x(\tfrac12+y-2x^2)=0$ and $y(\tfrac52+x-y)=0$.
euclid-2016-q7.summaryZh: (a) Amrita 与 Zhang 用一艘单人皮艇过湖；两人划艇速度均为 $7$ km/h，游泳速度均为 $2$ km/h。Amrita 先划艇而 Zhang 游泳，随后将艇停在湖中并改为游泳；Zhang 游到艇处后开始划艇。两人均在 $90$ 分钟后同时到岸。问皮艇静止了多长时间？(b) 求所有满足 $x(\tfrac12+y-2x^2)=0$ 与 $y(\tfrac52+x-y)=0$ 的实数对 $(x,y)$。

methods.title: Balance travel times and split the factored system into cases
methods.titleZh: 平衡行程时间并对因式方程组分类
steps: (a) Suppose Amrita paddles $p$ km and swims $s$ km. Zhang then swims $p$ km and paddles $s$ km. Equal total times give $p/7+s/2=p/2+s/7$, hence $p=s$.

Their common time is $p/7+p/2=3/2$, so $(9/14)p=3/2$ and $p=7/3$ km. Amrita leaves the kayak after $(7/3)/7=1/3$ hour, while Zhang reaches it after $(7/3)/2=7/6$ hours. The stationary interval is $7/6-1/3=5/6$ hour, or $50$ minutes.
(b) From the factored equations, either $x=0$ or $\frac12+y-2x=0$, and either $y=0$ or $\frac52+x-y=0$. If $x=0$, then $y=0$ or $5/2$. If $y=0$, then $x=0$ or $x=\pm1/2$ from $x(1/2-2x^2)=0$.

For $xy\ne0$, solve $1+2y-4x^2=0$ and $5+2x-2y=0$. Adding gives $6+2x-4x^2=0$, or $(2x-3)(x+1)=0$. Thus $x=3/2$ or $-1$, and $y=x+5/2$ gives $y=4$ or $3/2$. Combining all cases gives the six listed pairs.
stepsZh: (a) 设 Amrita 划艇 $p$ km、游泳 $s$ km，则 Zhang 游泳 $p$ km、划艇 $s$ km。两人总用时相同，所以 $p/7+s/2=p/2+s/7$，从而 $p=s$。

euclid-2016-q8.summary: (a) In parallelogram $ABCD$, point $E$ lies on $DC$ with $AE\perp DC$, and point $F$ lies on $CB$ with $AF\perp CB$. Given $AE=20$, $AF=32$, and $\cos\angle EAF=1/3$, find the exact area of quadrilateral $AECF$. (b) Find all $x>0$ satisfying $\log_4x-\log_x16=7/6-\log_x8$.
euclid-2016-q8.summaryZh: (a) 在平行四边形 $ABCD$ 中，点 $E$ 在 $DC$ 上且 $AE\perp DC$，点 $F$ 在 $CB$ 上且 $AF\perp CB$。已知 $AE=20$、$AF=32$、$\cos\angle EAF=1/3$，求四边形 $AECF$ 面积的精确值。(b) 求所有满足 $x>0$ 且 $\log_4x-\log_x16=7/6-\log_x8$ 的 $x$。

methods.title: Subtract two right triangles and change logarithm bases
methods.titleZh: 从平行四边形扣除两个直角三角形并换底
steps: (a) Put $\theta=\angle EAF$. Then $\cos\theta=1/3$ and, since $\theta$ is acute, $\sin\theta=\sqrt{1-1/9}=2\sqrt2/3$. Parallel sides and the two perpendiculars show that triangles $ABF$ and $ADE$ are right triangles with acute angle $\theta$.
In triangle $ABF$, $AF/AB=\sin\theta$, so $AB=32/(2\sqrt2/3)=24\sqrt2$ and $BF=AB\cos\theta=8\sqrt2$. Similarly, $AD=20/(2\sqrt2/3)=15\sqrt2$ and $DE=AD\cos\theta=5\sqrt2$.
Quadrilateral $AECF$ is the parallelogram minus triangles $ABF$ and $ADE$. Thus its area is $(AB)(AE)-\frac12(AF)(BF)-\frac12(AE)(DE)=480\sqrt2-128\sqrt2-50\sqrt2=302\sqrt2$.
(b) The logarithm bases require $x>0$ and $x\ne1$. Let $t=\log_2x\ne0$. By change of base, $\log_4x=t/2$, $\log_x16=4/t$, and $\log_x8=3/t$.
The equation becomes $t/2-4/t=7/6-3/t$, hence $t/2=7/6+1/t$. Multiplying by $6t$ gives $3t^2-7t-6=(3t+2)(t-3)=0$. Therefore $t=-2/3$ or $3$, yielding $x=2^{-2/3}$ or $x=8$.
stepsZh: (a) 令 $\theta=\angle EAF$。则 $\cos\theta=1/3$；因 $\theta$ 为锐角，$\sin\theta=\sqrt{1-1/9}=2\sqrt2/3$。由对边平行及两个垂直关系，三角形 $ABF,ADE$ 均为含锐角 $\theta$ 的直角三角形。
在三角形 $ABF$ 中，$AF/AB=\sin\theta$，故 $AB=32/(2\sqrt2/3)=24\sqrt2$，且 $BF=AB\cos\theta=8\sqrt2$。同理，$AD=20/(2\sqrt2/3)=15\sqrt2$，$DE=AD\cos\theta=5\sqrt2$。
四边形 $AECF$ 等于平行四边形扣除三角形 $ABF,ADE$，故面积为 $(AB)(AE)-\frac12(AF)(BF)-\frac12(AE)(DE)=480\sqrt2-128\sqrt2-50\sqrt2=302\sqrt2$。
(b) 对数底数要求 $x>0$ 且 $x\ne1$。令 $t=\log_2x\ne0$。由换底公式，$\log_4x=t/2$、$\log_x16=4/t$、$\log_x8=3/t$。

euclid-2016-q9.summary: (a) Count the length-$10$ strings over $\{A,B\}$ that do not contain the consecutive block $ABBA$. (b) In square $ABCD$, points $E,F$ lie on diagonal $AC$ in the order $A,E,F,C$, and $\angle EDF=45^\circ$. If $AE=x$, $EF=y$, and $FC=z$, prove $y^2=x^2+z^2$.
euclid-2016-q9.summaryZh: (a) 求由 $A,B$ 组成且不含连续子串 $ABBA$ 的长度为 $10$ 的字符串总数。(b) 在正方形 $ABCD$ 中，点 $E,F$ 按 $A,E,F,C$ 的顺序位于对角线 $AC$ 上，且 $\angle EDF=45^\circ$。若 $AE=x,EF=y,FC=z$，证明 $y^2=x^2+z^2$。

methods.title: Use a prefix-state recurrence and a quarter-turn rotation
methods.titleZh: 使用前缀状态递推与四分之一转旋转
steps: (a) Track the longest suffix that is also a proper prefix of $ABBA$. Use states $0,1,2,3$ for suffixes $\varnothing,A,AB,ABB$. From state $0$, letters $B,A$ lead to $0,1$; from $1$, $A,B$ lead to $1,2$; from $2$, $A,B$ lead to $1,3$; from $3$, $B$ leads to $0$, while $A$ is forbidden because it completes $ABBA$.

(b) Rotate triangle $DFC$ by $90^\circ$ counterclockwise about $D$, sending $C$ to $A$ and $F$ to $F'$. Then $F'A=FC=z$, $DF'=DF$, and $\angle F'DE=45^\circ=\angle FDE$; the latter follows by combining the quarter-turn with $\angle EDF=45^\circ$.

Triangles $F'DE$ and $FDE$ are congruent by SAS, so $F'E=FE=y$. Because $AC$ is a square diagonal, $AE$ makes $45^\circ$ with $AD$, while $AF'$ makes $45^\circ$ on the other side; hence $\angle F'AE=90^\circ$.
Pythagoras in right triangle $F'AE$ gives $F'E^2=F'A^2+AE^2$. Substituting $F'E=y$, $F'A=z$, and $AE=x$ yields $y^2=z^2+x^2$.
stepsZh: (a) 记录当前字符串的最长后缀，使其同时为 $ABBA$ 的真前缀。用状态 $0,1,2,3$ 分别表示后缀 $\varnothing,A,AB,ABB$。从状态 $0$ 加 $B,A$ 分别到 $0,1$；从 $1$ 加 $A,B$ 到 $1,2$；从 $2$ 加 $A,B$ 到 $1,3$；从 $3$ 加 $B$ 到 $0$，而加 $A$ 会形成 $ABBA$，应禁止。
(b) 将三角形 $DFC$ 绕 $D$ 逆时针旋转 $90^\circ$，使 $C$ 映到 $A$、$F$ 映到 $F'$。于是 $F'A=FC=z$、$DF'=DF$，且结合四分之一转与 $\angle EDF=45^\circ$ 可得 $\angle F'DE=45^\circ=\angle FDE$。
三角形 $F'DE$ 与 $FDE$ 由边角边全等，故 $F'E=FE=y$。正方形对角线 $AC$ 与 $AD$ 成 $45^\circ$，而 $AF'$ 位于另一侧也成 $45^\circ$，所以 $\angle F'AE=90^\circ$。
在直角三角形 $F'AE$ 中使用勾股定理，得到 $F'E^2=F'A^2+AE^2$。代入 $F'E=y$、$F'A=z$、$AE=x$，即得 $y^2=z^2+x^2$。

euclid-2016-q10.summary: For $k\ge2$, each of two bags contains balls labelled $1,2,\ldots,k$, and one ball is chosen uniformly from each bag. Let $P(k)$ be the probability that the product of the two labels is divisible by $k$. (a) Find $P(10)$. (b) Find a polynomial $f(n)$ such that $P(n)\ge f(n)/n^2$ for every $n\ge2$, with equality for infinitely many $n$. (c) Prove that some positive integer $m$ satisfies $P(m)>2016/m$.
euclid-2016-q10.summaryZh: 对 $k\ge2$，两个袋中各有标号 $1,2,\ldots,k$ 的球，每袋等可能取一球。令 $P(k)$ 为两球标号之积能被 $k$ 整除的概率。(a) 求 $P(10)$。(b) 求一个多项式 $f(n)$，使对所有 $n\ge2$ 都有 $P(n)\ge f(n)/n^2$，并且等号对无穷多个 $n$ 成立。(c) 证明存在正整数 $m$ 使 $P(m)>2016/m$。

methods.title: Count ordered pairs and exploit powers of two
methods.titleZh: 统计有序数对并利用二的幂
steps: (a) There are $100$ ordered pairs $(a,b)$. If $a=10$ or $b=10$, there are $10+10-1=19$ successful pairs. Otherwise a factor $5$ must come from one label being $5$, and the other must be one of $2,4,6,8$, giving $8$ more ordered pairs. Hence $P(10)=(19+8)/100=27/100$.
(b) For every $n\ge2$, all pairs with $a=n$ or $b=n$ succeed. There are $n+n-1=2n-1$ such pairs among $n^2$, so $P(n)\ge(2n-1)/n^2$. Thus take $f(n)=2n-1$.

If $n=p$ is prime, $p\mid ab$ implies $p\mid a$ or $p\mid b$. Since $1\le a,b\le p$, this means $a=p$ or $b=p$, so the preceding $2p-1$ pairs are the only successful ones. Therefore equality holds for every prime $p$, and hence for infinitely many $n$.

(c) Let $N=2^k$. For each $j=1,\ldots,k-1$, count pairs $(a,b)=(2^jx,2^{k-j}y)$ with $x,y$ odd and the labels at most $N$. There are $2^{k-j-1}$ choices for $x$ and $2^{j-1}$ for $y$, hence $2^{k-2}$ pairs for each $j$; pairs from different $j$ are distinct because the exact power of $2$ dividing $a$ differs.
Thus at least $(k-1)2^{k-2}$ of the $N^2$ pairs succeed, so $P(N)\ge(k-1)/(4N)$. Choose $k=8066$ and $m=N=2^{8066}$. Then $(k-1)/4=8065/4>2016$, giving $P(m)>2016/m$.
stepsZh: (a) 共有 $100$ 个有序数对 $(a,b)$。若 $a=10$ 或 $b=10$，成功数对有 $10+10-1=19$ 个。否则因数 $5$ 必须来自某个标号为 $5$ 的球，而另一个标号必须为 $2,4,6,8$ 之一，共再得 $8$ 个有序数对。因此 $P(10)=(19+8)/100=27/100$。
(b) 对任意 $n\ge2$，所有满足 $a=n$ 或 $b=n$ 的数对均成功，共有 $n+n-1=2n-1$ 个。因此 $P(n)\ge(2n-1)/n^2$，可取 $f(n)=2n-1$。
若 $n=p$ 为质数，则 $p\mid ab$ 推出 $p\mid a$ 或 $p\mid b$。因 $1\le a,b\le p$，这等价于 $a=p$ 或 $b=p$，所以上述 $2p-1$ 个数对就是全部成功数对。故每个质数 $p$ 都取等号，而质数有无穷多个。
(c) 令 $N=2^k$。对每个 $j=1,\ldots,k-1$，统计形如 $(a,b)=(2^jx,2^{k-j}y)$ 的数对，其中 $x,y$ 为奇数且标号不超过 $N$。$x$ 有 $2^{k-j-1}$ 种，$y$ 有 $2^{j-1}$ 种，因此每个 $j$ 给出 $2^{k-2}$ 个数对；不同 $j$ 产生的数对因 $a$ 中恰含的因子 $2$ 次数不同而互异。
